===== Features =====

This agent = AI understanding/planning ＋ Skill orchestration ＋ cross-app AppFunction execution.
The selected AI provider understands the instruction and plans the actions, Skill orchestrates
multi-step flows, and AppFunction calls the real capabilities exposed by Gallery / Settings /
file manager apps.

[How to use]
1. Tap "⚙ Config" in the top-right corner to select an AI provider and fill in the API Key
 (apply on each platform); the model can be left blank to use the default;
2. Type a natural-language instruction in the "Agent Prompt" box and click "Run Agent";
3. You can also click 🎤 Voice input; after recognition, tick "Run automatically after
 recognition" to execute directly;
4. The middle SVG panel shows the execution flow in real time, and the right run log prints
 the result of every step.

[Available features and example instructions]
□ Gallery media (gallery): open an image, play a video, add a filter to an image and save
 e.g. open /sdcard/Download/bella.jpg
 e.g. play /sdcard/Movies/clip.mp4
 e.g. add a black_white filter to /sdcard/Download/a.jpg and save

□ System settings (settings): open settings pages, adjust brightness/volume/mute, dark mode
 e.g. open Wi-Fi settings / open display settings / open app settings
 e.g. make the screen a bit brighter (dim makes it darker)
 e.g. turn the volume up by 50% (volume_down makes it smaller)
 e.g. mute / unmute / enable dark mode / disable dark mode
 e.g. disable dark mode and set brightness to maximum (multiple instructions in one run)

□ Open an app (app_open): open any app by package name or app name
 e.g. open Settings / open Gallery / open com.android.settings

□ File management (file_op): delete (move to trash), move, rename, empty trash
 e.g. delete Desktop/a.txt
 e.g. move the files in Desktop/temp to Desktop/archive
 e.g. rename report.txt to report2026.txt
 e.g. empty trash

□ File search (file_search): search files in a directory by extension/keyword
 e.g. find *.png in /mnt/sdcard/Pictures

□ File lookup (file_find): find files in a folder by name / modified-time filters,
 find large files, find files unused for N days (read-only DocumentsUI AppFunctions)
 e.g. find *.pdf under Desktop
 e.g. find all files in Desktop/Pictures not modified in the last 3 months
 e.g. find files larger than 500MB under /mnt/sdcard
 e.g. find files not used for 30 days under /mnt/sdcard/Downloads

□ Bulk file delete (file_delete): delete matching files by name prefix / suffix or by
 last-modified time, or delete an explicitly listed path (moved to trash, recoverable)
 e.g. delete all .tmp files under Desktop/Temp (recursive)
 e.g. delete files in Desktop/old modified before 2026-01-01 midnight
 e.g. delete /mnt/sdcard/Download/a.png

□ Task record (task_create): write text to a file and read it back for verification
 e.g. record "write weekly report" to /data/local/tmp/task.txt

□ FDE curated apps store (curated_apps, com.fde.download): list curated apps and their
 install/update state, background download + silent install a curated app
 e.g. what curated apps can I install
 e.g. install WeChat (com.tencent.mm) from the curated store

You are an Android agent that understands user intent and plans tasks onto registered Skills.\nAvailable Skills:\n

Rules:
- Each user instruction maps to one Skill task (skill + inputs): skill must be an id from the list above, inputs follow the declared parameters of that Skill.
- A single request may contain multiple instructions (e.g. "turn off dark mode and set brightness to maximum"): put every task in the tasks array of the run_skills tool in one call (do not return only the first one, and do not split into multiple turns). Tasks are executed in array order.
- When skill tasks match, only call the run_skills tool; answer directly only when the user is just chatting, asking questions, or no Skill matches (e.g. "log in", "send a message") — never invent Skills or tools.
- Try to fill in the inputs completely based on the user wording; use reasonable defaults when important ones are missing; only ask the user to supply when truly missing.
- Brightness: to set the maximum use action=brighten, step=100; minimum use action=dim, step=100. Volume works the same way: volume_step=100 is maximum.
- Paths must be absolute paths on the device.

The list of Skill tasks to execute. Each element is an object with skill and inputs fields, and one user instruction maps to one task. Whenever the request contains executable instructions, you MUST list all tasks here in a single call.
